text:
sam: Heads up - in staging a few private tenants got routed to hosted and the probe context vanished, so hosted treated the requests as public and served fallback models. Repro included.

ivy: looks like the sidecarless proxy path strips x-infer-probe during handoff. We need a principled way to assert probe provenance across hosting boundaries.

rajesh: brainstorm of safe options: 1) mTLS client cert presented on handoff, 2) compact signed probe assertion (JWS) signed by tenant key, 3) opaque sync tokens pushed via optional federation, 4) header re-injection but only for explicit opt-in tenants.

talia: security note: header re-injection is easiest but forgeable. Signed assertions or mTLS give cryptographic provenance and work for air-gapped / regulated setups if we exchange trust artifacts at onboarding.

sam: proposal: declare a probe_provenance_mode in the tenant manifest with enum [mtls,signed,opaque,header_opt_in]. Hosted defaults to strict deny if missing.

ivy: implementation sketches:
- mtls: tenant sidecar (or proxy) presents short-lived client cert on egress. Hosted validates chain and SAN includes lease id. Requires onboarding CA exchange (hosted-issued subordinate or customer-provided CA).
- signed: sidecar creates a compact assertion {lease,iat,exp,probe_meta} -> JWS signed by tenant key. Hosted verifies via tenant public key exchanged at onboarding. Cache verified assertion per-lease to avoid per-request crypto.
- opaque: private controlplane periodically pushes valid tokens to hosted verifier (federation). Hosted validates against cache. Low per-request cost but needs optional egress.
- header_opt_in: only allowed if tenant sets opt-in flag; must be audited and reversible.

rajesh: perf: verify-once-per-lease caching for signed and opaque; mTLS benefits from TLS session reuse. We should instrument a lease-verification cache and invalidation on lease end.

talia: policy: default fail-closed (deny) on unverifiable probe. Allow per-tenant opt-in to fail-open with strong audit events. Emit metric fallback.reason=probe_unverified vs resource_shortage.

ops-bot: ci job handshake-provenance-matrix queued -> job/handshake-provenance/v1 :white_check_mark:

sam: UX: console shows "Probe provenance" mode, last verified lease, and upload area for trust artifacts (certs or public keys) for air-gapped onboarding. Also surface a help doc with tradeoffs.

ivy: docs/manifest: add probe_provenance_mode + trust_artifact references and an explicit header_opt_in boolean. Backwards compatibility: absent field -> secure default (deny).

rajesh: action items:
- ivy: PR for manifest schema + validation tests (2d)
- talia: security review on storing tenant pubkeys/cert bundles and federation endpoints (3d)
- sam: small proxy patch to preserve header only for header_opt_in tenants and add integration test (1d)
- ops-bot: run handshake-provenance-matrix and post results here

ivy: one more: add audit event when hosted accepts a probe-derived route with fields {tenant,lease,mode,verifier_result,handback_origin}. Also add an alert if probe-derived fallbacks spike.

sam: thanks - will file RFC follow-up and link this convo. Let's review prototypes Friday 10am.
